basic_info.description: Perched atop Nob Hill, this sleek 3-bed, 2-bath condo is the ultimate urban retreat. Soaring ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and an open-concept layout create a bright, airy space. The gourmet kitchen, outfitted with top-of-the-line appliances, is perfect for hosting dinner parties. The primary suite is a private oasis, complete with a spa-like bathroom, ample closets, and stunning peek-a-boo views of the bay and Coit Tower. Two additional bedrooms offer flexibility for guests or a home office. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry and deeded storage. Take in panoramic city views from the shared rooftop deck, including iconic landmarks like the Transamerica Pyramid, Treasure Island and the Bay Bridge. This prime location puts you steps away from the Financial District, North Beach, and Polk Street. Well managed 3 unit HOA with low monthly dues. With a Transit Score of 100, and a Walk Score of 99, getting around the city is a breeze!
